scope.scope_label: INSPECT-7 Book 1 Chapter 1.1 Dutch quality evidence prototype
scope.repository_context: 4veco-platform quality-standards prototype with read-only citations to ../4veco-lessen.

teacher_first_screen.scope_summary: This report-only prototype organises 4veco product-side evidence for Book 1, Chapter 1.1: 1.1.1 Schaarste en economisch denken, 1.1.2 Percentages en indexcijfers, and 1.1.3 Grafieken en tabellen.
teacher_first_screen.safe_use_note: This pack organises bounded 4veco product evidence. It is not an Inspectie judgement, approval, certificate, PTA validation, summative assessment judgement, OP0 completion claim, or proof of classroom implementation. The school owns the full curriculum, implementation, support, assessment, governance, and inspection conversation.
category_summary: curriculum_offer: usable but weak because target exercises and generated lesson folders exist, while target exercises remain migrated/needs-review and exam-code links are absent.
basic_skills: present when bounded to economics reasoning, calculation, graph/table reading, source/value selection, and answer construction.
didactic_quality: present through paragraph plans, reviewed Part A material, companion reviews, worked examples, guided practice, and route surfaces.
student_development_and_support: present but weak because advisory checks and routes exist, but school monitoring and support decisions are not product evidence.
assessment_and_closure: present but weak because only 1.1.2 has reviewed local target-equivalent proof.
accessibility_and_inclusion: present but weak because review evidence exists but not a unified full accessibility audit.
quality_assurance: present through quality-ref YAML, Part A reviews, companion reviews, validators, sprints, lead reviews, and platform validation.
improvement_cycle: present as product improvement evidence, not school self-evaluation.
top_weak_or_missing_evidence: No full OP0 or school-wide basic-skills proof.
No school implementation, monitoring, support, care, PTA, grading, governance, or inspection-dialogue evidence.
Target exercises remain migrated/needs-review and lack exam-code links for the three paragraphs.
Target-equivalent proof is reviewed only for the local 1.1.2 case; 1.1.1 and 1.1.3 remain unapproved for completion-language claims.
Review evidence is useful but not a full accessibility audit.
school_evidence_still_needed_summary: School curriculum plan, scheduling, classroom enactment, and local policy choices.
School-wide basic-skills curriculum and practice for Dutch language, mathematics/arithmetic, and citizenship.
Student monitoring, interventions, accommodations, care plans, and support decisions.
PTA, grading, summative assessment policy, and transition decisions.
School governance, self-evaluation, board accountability, and inspection conversation.
teacher_first_screen.recommended_next_action: Use this prototype for external teacher, legal/privacy, and Dutch quality-inspection review. Treat weak evidence as visible review guidance, not as product approval or school evidence.
